question.worked_solution:
We use the central difference approximation

$$
{f}^{′}(x)≈\frac{f(x+h)-f(x-h)}{2h}
$$

 
at the point $x=1.5$ with the step size $h=0.25.$ This gives

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}^{′}(x) & ≈\frac{f(x+h)-f(x-h)}{2h} \\ {f}^{′}(1.5) & ≈\frac{f(1.5+0.25)-f(1.5-0.25)}{2(0.25)} \\  & =\frac{f(1.75)-f(1.25)}{0.5} \\  & =\frac{-0.50-0.75}{0.5} \\  & =\frac{(-1.25)}{0.5} \\  & =-2.5.\end{aligned}
$$
